info.name: Order and Payment API
info.description:
Start the Laravel API, import this collection, and run folders in order. The collection includes all variables and works without an environment. Register creates a unique account and saves its token; order requests capture IDs; payment requests generate and reuse UUID keys automatically.

Optional environment: import Local.postman_environment.json to override base_url only.

1. Authentication: register, login, and inspect the current account.
2. Orders: create, update, confirm, list, show, and delete a disposable order.
3. Payments: simulate failure, retry, replay the same payment, list attempts, and use PayPal.
4. Business Rule Examples: intentional error cases with assertions for expected statuses.

Both gateways are simulators. No real card details or external account is required. Prices are decimal strings; totals are calculated by the server. All account/order/payment queries and business rules live in services.
